items.item: A left navigation groups the settings sections
items.evidence: <nav aria-label="Settings" id="setNav"> with group labels 'Company' (General, Localization), 'Preferences' (Notifications) and a bordered Danger zone link; visible in the screenshot left of the content.

items.item: Each section uses one save model consistently (per-section save); autosave is used only for toggles and says so
items.evidence: General and Localization forms each have a sticky bar with Cancel + Save (barHtml, submitForm) and an 'Unsaved changes' indicator plus a leave guard. Notifications autosaves checkboxes (flashSaved shows 'Saved') and its intro says 'Every change applies immediately.' The digest select also autosaves (not a toggle), a minor deviation but it is covered by the same statement.

items.item: Localization settings show a formatted preview of a date and an amount
items.evidence: renderPreview()/localizationPreview() fill #locPreview with 'Date and time' (dateFmt + Intl time), 'Amount' (Intl.NumberFormat currency of 1250000.5) and 'Number', updated live on input/change.

items.item: Every toggle has a visible label and states what it controls
items.evidence: Notification checkboxes sit in a table with visible row headers (e.g. 'Invoice overdue' + hint 'When a customer invoice passes its due date') and column headers 'Email' / 'In-app'; each input also has an aria-label 'Billing – Invoice overdue – Email'. Digest select has a visible label 'Send a summary email'. Not seen in the screenshot (Notifications section is not the default view), so judged from markup.

items.item: The danger zone is separated at the end and its destructive action requires typing the company name or an equally strong confirmation
items.evidence: 'Danger zone' is the last nav item, set off by border-t and in red; its section has a red-bordered panel. openDelete() shows 'Type <company name> to confirm' (#typed) and the confirm button stays disabled until inp.value === name (typedConfirm). Transfer ownership requires the same typed name.

items.item: Success is confirmed briefly; errors appear inline next to the field and persist
items.evidence:
toast() auto-dismisses after 5000ms (paused on hover/focus) with a dismiss button. Field errors are rendered by setError() into the [data-err]

under the field with aria-invalid, red icon+text, and only clear when the value is fixed. Server-style error on website (acme.com) is also inline. A summary box appears at 3 or more errors.

notes: Audit score 100 with no violations. No template tells observed: no greeting header, KPI tiles, gradients, glass, uppercase tracking, emoji icons, promo card, decorative charts, card-in-card, hover lift or oversized radius (radii 4px only; the rounded-md Preview box and danger panel are single level). Sidebar is light slate with blue-700 accent, not navy/indigo. The 'LT' avatar is the signed-in person and the 'N' tile is a logo mark, so neither counts as initials-avatar-non-person. Minor: the digest select autosaves though it is not a toggle; the Danger zone is a separate nav section rather than at the end of one long page, but it is last and visually separated. Only the first viewport screenshot was checked; the full-page screenshot was not opened and the Notifications and Danger sections were judged from markup.
